# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by TestReferenceDocs in platform/internal/cli; do not edit. -->

Fleet commands talk to the Hub in `--hub`/`--token` (or `AGEN_HUB`/`AGEN_TOKEN`), else to the local `agen up`.

```text
agen — run and manage agent fleets

Platform:
  agen up                         Hub + local Nest in one process (SQLite)
  agen down                       stop a running 'agen up' (drains instances)
  agen ui                         sign-in link for the web UI
  agen hub serve                  run a Hub
  agen nest run --hub URL         run a Nest Manager
  agen migrate --to URL           copy the local store into Postgres (distributed)
  agen store host-role            create the least-privilege Postgres role for Nests

Fleet (client of the Hub; --hub/--token or AGEN_HUB/AGEN_TOKEN, else the local config from agen up):
  agen init [dir]                 write a template bundle to start from (--template NAME; --list)
  agen deploy <bundle-dir>        create or update a deployment (--validate: check only)
  agen scale <name> <n>           set desired instances
  agen ps [--all]                 deployments (--all: every instance on every nest)
  agen logs <name> [-f]           operational logs
  agen stop <name>                stop all instances and hold at zero (paused)
  agen start <name>               resume a stopped deployment
  agen rm <name>                  delete a deployment
  agen run <name> <input>         submit a task and wait for its result
  agen call <name> <text>         A2A message to the deployment (wakes it if asleep)
  agen tasks [name]               recent tasks
  agen runs [name]                recent runs (--roots: one per trace, --status, --label)
  agen trace <task-id|trace-id>   span tree of a trace, across agents
  agen transcript <run|task>      what a run sent to the model and got back, tool calls included
  agen triggers <name>            trigger events (fired, missed, rejected)
  agen webhook-secret <name> <trigger>  create/rotate a webhook secret
  agen secret set|ls|rm           platform secrets (bundle secrets with source "platform")
  agen resolve <name>             A2A endpoints of a deployment and a call token
  agen nests                      enrolled nests
  agen approvals | approve <id> | deny <id>
  agen notify set|ls|rm           where the Hub POSTs a namespace's events
  agen join-token                 one-time token for 'agen nest run'
  agen token create --scope S     API token
  agen whoami                     the current token's identity and scopes
  agen version
```

## agen up

```text
Usage of up:
  -capacity int
    	local nest capacity (0 = unlimited) (default 8)
  -gateway-listen string
    	local Gateway (A2A) listen address (default "127.0.0.1:7071")
  -host-bin string
    	agen-host executable
  -listen string
    	Hub listen address (default "127.0.0.1:7070")
  -retention duration
    	delete spans, log lines and trigger events older than this (0 keeps them) (default 720h0m0s)
  -store string
    	store URL (default: sqlite in AGEN_HOME)
```

## agen down

```text
usage: agen down
```

## agen ui

```text
Usage of ui:
  -ca-hash string
    	pin the Hub CA of an https Hub
  -hub string
    	Hub URL
  -json
    	print the API response as JSON
  -n string
    	namespace (default "default")
  -token string
    	API token
```

## agen hub serve

```text
Usage of hub serve:
  -listen string
    	listen address (default "127.0.0.1:7070")
  -nest-cert-lifetime duration
    	lifetime of Nest client certificates (default 30 days; Nests renew before expiry)
  -retention duration
    	delete spans, log lines and trigger events older than this (0 keeps them) (default 720h0m0s)
  -store string
    	store URL (sqlite:<path> or postgres://...)
  -tls
    	serve HTTPS with the Hub CA; Nests enrol with certificates (mTLS)
  -tls-host value
    	extra host name or IP for the Hub certificate (repeatable)
```

## agen nest run

```text
Usage of nest run:
  -backend string
    	where instances run: native (child processes) or kubernetes (pods; run the nest in a pod) (default "native")
  -ca-hash string
    	pin the Hub CA (from 'agen join-token') for an https Hub
  -capacity int
    	maximum instances (0 = unlimited) (default 8)
  -cert-renew-before duration
    	mTLS: renew the Nest certificate when less than this remains (default 10 days)
  -data-dir string
    	nest state directory (default: AGEN_HOME/nests/<name>)
  -gateway-auth string
    	required: A2A callers need a Hub-signed call token; optional: anonymous callers allowed (loopback gateways only) (default "required")
  -gateway-listen string
    	Gateway listen address (default "127.0.0.1:7071")
  -gateway-url string
    	public URL of this nest's Gateway (default: from --gateway-listen)
  -host-bin string
    	agen-host executable
  -host-env value
    	pass this variable from the nest's environment to every instance, e.g. a provider key (repeatable)
  -host-env-dir string
    	pass each file in this directory (name = variable, content = value; e.g. a mounted secret) to every instance
  -host-memory-limit string
    	native backend: cap each agent host's memory, e.g. 1GiB (Windows job limit, Linux RLIMIT_AS)
  -hub string
    	Hub URL
  -join-token string
    	one-time join token (first start only)
  -kube-cpu-limit string
    	kubernetes: CPU limit per instance pod (default "1")
  -kube-image string
    	kubernetes: image with agen-host for instance pods
  -kube-memory-limit string
    	kubernetes: memory limit per instance pod (default "1Gi")
  -kube-namespace string
    	kubernetes: namespace for instance pods (default: the nest pod's)
  -label value
    	nest label key=value (repeatable)
  -manager-listen string
    	ManagerService listen address for host callbacks (kubernetes default 0.0.0.0:7072)
  -manager-url string
    	URL hosts use to reach ManagerService (kubernetes default http://$POD_IP:<port>)
  -name string
    	nest name (default: hostname)
  -store string
    	store URL given to instances for run data
  -store-for value
    	NAMESPACE=URL: store URL for that namespace's instances, e.g. a role limited to it (repeatable)
  -store-for-only
    	run only namespaces that have a --store-for entry (no fallback to --store)
```

## agen migrate

```text
Usage of migrate:
  -from string
    	source store URL (default: the local agen up store)
  -to string
    	target store URL, empty (e.g. postgres://user:pass@host/db)
```

## agen store

```text
usage: agen store host-role --store postgres://<admin>@host/db [--role agen_host]  (password from AGEN_HOST_DB_PASSWORD)
```

## agen init

```text
Usage of init:
  -example string
    	same as --template
  -list
    	list the templates
  -template string
    	template to start from: hello, researcher, writer, editor, support-triage, pr-reviewer, fleet-steward, cost-watchdog, approval-triage, assistant (default "hello")
```
